thread:
Maya: Heads up - noticed a mismatch on INV-8721 after the new price sheet rolled out to the early cohort. Looks like the legacy discount didn't carry over for the `seed-2023` cohort, customer billed $1,200 instead of $800.
Jon: Oof. Which customer and timeframe? Can we confirm it's a mapping issue and not a usage spike?
Maya: Customer CUST-123, billing period Mar 1-31. Usage lines look normal, subtotal difference is exactly the discount delta so mapping seems likely.
Prasad: Pulling pricing table now. Quick question - did we flip the experiment flag for seed-2023 or create a new price_id?
Olivia: We created a new price_id for the AB rollout (price_v2) and intended to backfill the legacy discount via the grandfather mapping. Looks like the backfill rule wasn't included in the upload manifest.
Eli: Customer already reached out, asking for an explanation and a credit. They expect a one-off adjustment.
Maya: Proposed fix: issue a one-time credit of $400 against INV-8721 and update the price mapping so future invoices use the correct discount. Any objections? :thinking_face:
Jon: Sounds reasonable. Anything > $250 needs finance manager sign-off per policy. @Olivia can you sign off?
Olivia: Approved. Please include a short note in the rollout changelog and the customer email. :thumbsup:
Prasad: I can run the backfill and schedule the credit. Command I'll run (sanity first):
```
# dry-run to calculate totals
billing-cli invoices reconcile --invoice INV-8721 --dry-run
# create credit
billing-cli credits create --customer CUST-123 --amount 400 --reason "legacy discount carryover" --invoice INV-8721
```
Maya: Can you hold the job for 30m? I want to confirm the customer contact and draft the message.
Prasad: Yep holding. Will run after Maya confirms.
BillingBot: Invoice INV-8721 generated 2026-03-01 02:15 UTC. Status: paid. Credit operations will create a negative line item and update ledger on apply.
Eli: I'll prep the customer message: short apology, explain a one-time credit, and confirm no changes to usage. Will send it to Maya for review.
Maya: Thanks - once credit is queued, please add a note to the invoice and tag internal ticket FIN-2345. I'll also add a checkbox to the rollout playbook to ensure manifest includes grandfathering rules next time.
Jon: After credit, let's monitor the next billing cycle for seed-2023 cohort for any other misses. Assign a watcher? @Prasad can you and @Olivia pair on that?
Prasad: Yup, will schedule an hourly check for next 72h.
Olivia: I'll update the rollout doc and mark this as a postmortem follow-up.
Maya: Perfect - thanks everyone. I'll post the customer-facing note here after review. :white_check_mark:
